{"type":"api-request-blob","sessionId":"12c6389f-50bb-452b-bb07-f08bd624cfd6","hash":"423d9f05fba33ef2653a260a3c9c20288a64a52e4b878e29c8c5093d8c12971f","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01F1FtsDfA6qpPBnh31XLPhP","type":"tool_result","content":"\"\"\"Console plumbing shared by every route: templates, the signed session\ncookie, CSRF tokens, flash messages, and the signed-in guard.\n\nThe session cookie (Starlette's SessionMiddleware, signed with itsdangerous\nusing CMS_SECRET_KEY) holds only three things: the session id, the CSRF token,\nand pending flash messages. Who is signed in is decided by the `sessions`\ntable, never by the cookie alone.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport secrets\nfrom collections.abc import Callable\nfrom typing import Annotated\n\nfrom fastapi import Depends, Request\nfrom fastapi.responses import HTMLResponse, PlainTextResponse, RedirectResponse\nfrom fastapi.templating import Jinja2Templates\nfrom starlette.datastructures import FormData\n\nfrom app import accounts, db, settings\n\nSESSION_COOKIE = \"cms_session\"\nSESSION_MAX_AGE = 12 * 60 * 60  # seconds; sign in again after half a day\n\ntemplates = Jinja2Templates(directory=str(settings.TEMPLATES))\n\n\ndef csrf_token(request: Request) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The token every console form carries as a hidden `csrf_token` field.\"\"\"\n    token = request.session.get(\"csrf\")\n    if not token:\n        token = request.session[\"csrf\"] = secrets.token_urlsafe(32)\n    return token\n\n\nSAFE_METHODS = {\"GET\", \"HEAD\", \"OPTIONS\"}\n\n\nclass CsrfRejected(Exception):\n    \"\"\"A state-changing request whose form lacks this session's token.\"\"\"\n\n\nasync def verify_csrf(request: Request) -> None:\n    \"\"\"App-wide dependency: every POST (or other unsafe method) must carry the\n    session's CSRF token in its form, or it is refused before the route runs.\"\"\"\n    if request.method in SAFE_METHODS:\n        return\n    expected = request.session.get(\"csrf\")\n    sent = (await request.form()).get(\"csrf_token\")\n    if not expected or not isinstance(sent, str) or not secrets.compare_digest(sent, expected):\n        raise CsrfRejected\n\n\nasync def csrf_rejected_handler(request: Request, exc: Exception) -> PlainTextResponse:\n    return PlainTextResponse(\"请求已过期或来源不明，请返回刷新页面后重试。\",\n                             status_code=403)\n\n\ndef form_text(form: FormData, name: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"A form field as text. A missing one (or a file) counts as blank, so it\n    gets the console's message rather than a 422.\"\"\"\n    value = form.get(name)\n    return value if isinstance(value, str) else \"\"\n\n\n_LARGEST_ID = 2 ** 63 - 1  # SQLite's largest integer\n\n\ndef id_or_none(value: str) -> int | None:\n    \"\"\"A form's or query's id field as a number, or None if it holds anything\n    but ASCII digits or a number too large to be an id.\"\"\"\n    value = value.strip()\n    if not (value.isascii() and value.isdigit()):\n        return None\n    number = int(value)\n    return number if number <= _LARGEST_ID else None\n\n\ndef flash(request: Request, message: str, kind: str = \"success\") -> None:\n    \"\"\"Queue a message for the next page shown. kind: success | notice | error.\"\"\"\n    request.session.setdefault(\"flash\", []).append([kind, message])\n\n\ndef pop_flashes(request: Request) -> list[list[str]]:\n    return request.session.pop(\"flash\", [])\n\n\ndef console_root(request: Request) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The relative path from this page back to the console root (\"\" at\n    /login, \"../\" at /admin/guides, \"../../../\" at /admin/guides/5/edit).\n    Templates put it in front of every console link, so no link is\n    root-absolute and none depends on which route rendered the page. A\n    mount prefix (root_path) is part of the console root, so it is not\n    climbed out of.\"\"\"\n    path = request.url.path.removeprefix(request.scope.get(\"root_path\", \"\"))\n    return \"../\" * (path.count(\"/\") - 1)\n\n\ntemplates.env.globals[\"csrf_token\"] = csrf_token\ntemplates.env.globals[\"pop_flashes\"] = pop_flashes\ntemplates.env.globals[\"console_root\"] = console_root\ntemplates.env.globals[\"submission_banned\"] = accounts.SUBMISSION_BANNED\ntemplates.env.globals[\"min_password_length\"] = accounts.MIN_PASSWORD_LENGTH\n\n\ndef start_session(request: Request, session_id: str) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Replace the cookie's contents, so nothing from before login survives\n    (the CSRF token is reissued on the next page).\"\"\"\n    request.session.clear()\n    request.session[\"sid\"] = session_id\n\n\nclass LoginRequired(Exception):\n    \"\"\"Raised when nobody is signed in; answered with a redirect to /login.\"\"\"\n\n\nclass SetupRequired(Exception):\n    \"\"\"Raised when the user still has first-login setup to do; answered with a\n    redirect to /admin/setup.\"\"\"\n\n\ndef signed_in_user_mid_setup(request: Request) -> accounts.User:\n    \"\"\"Dependency for the setup page only: the signed-in user, whether or not\n    they have finished first-login setup.\"\"\"\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        user = accounts.user_for_session(conn, request.session.get(\"sid\"))\n    if user is None:\n        raise LoginRequired\n    return user\n\n\ndef signed_in_user(request: Request) -> accounts.User:\n    \"\"\"Dependency for every other console page: the signed-in user, who has\n    finished first-login setup. Anyone else is redirected.\"\"\"\n    user = signed_in_user_mid_setup(request)\n    if user.needs_setup:\n        raise SetupRequired\n    return user\n\n\nclass AdminRequired(Exception):\n    \"\"\"Raised when an Editor reaches an Admin-only page; answered with a 403\n    console page, which keeps the navigation for the signed-in `user`.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self, user: accounts.User) -> None:\n        super().__init__()\n        self.user = user\n\n\n# Every guard made by requires(), so a test can find every route behind one.\nADMIN_GUARDS: set[Callable[..., accounts.User]] = set()\n\n\ndef requires(capability: str) -> Callable[..., accounts.User]:\n    \"\"\"A dependency for Admin-only pages: the signed-in user, if they have\n    `capability`. Anyone else is refused, whether they followed a link or\n    typed the URL. Make one per capability at import time, so FastAPI's\n    per-request cache recognises it.\"\"\"\n    def guard(user: Annotated[accounts.User, Depends(signed_in_user)]) -> accounts.User:\n        if not user.can(capability):\n            raise AdminRequired(user)\n        return user\n    ADMIN_GUARDS.add(guard)\n    return guard\n\n\nadmin_user = requires(\"manage_game\")\n\n\ndef home_for(user: accounts.User) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Where a signed-in user belongs: setup first, then the dashboard.\"\"\"\n    return \"/admin/setup\" if user.needs_setup else \"/admin/dashboard\"\n\n\ndef redirect(url: str) -> RedirectResponse:\n    return RedirectResponse(url, status_code=303)\n\n\nasync def login_required_handler(request: Request, exc: Exception) -> RedirectResponse:\n    return {"parentUuid":"3f754c9d-eca4-4614-8968-3bcd05f705c7","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"92f2c8fb-e9e7-4ccf-b4e2-f36839dbe2c5","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01F1FtsDfA6qpPBnh31XLPhP","type":"tool_result","content":"\"\"\"Console plumbing shared by every route: templates, the signed session\ncookie, CSRF tokens, flash messages, and the signed-in guard.\n\nThe session cookie (Starlette's SessionMiddleware, signed with itsdangerous\nusing CMS_SECRET_KEY) holds only three things: the session id, the CSRF token,\nand pending flash messages. Who is signed in is decided by the `sessions`\ntable, never by the cookie alone.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport secrets\nfrom collections.abc import Callable\nfrom typing import Annotated\n\nfrom fastapi import Depends, Request\nfrom fastapi.responses import HTMLResponse, PlainTextResponse, RedirectResponse\nfrom fastapi.templating import Jinja2Templates\nfrom starlette.datastructures import FormData\n\nfrom app import accounts, db, settings\n\nSESSION_COOKIE = \"cms_session\"\nSESSION_MAX_AGE = 12 * 60 * 60  # seconds; sign in again after half a day\n\ntemplates = Jinja2Templates(directory=str(settings.TEMPLATES))\n\n\ndef csrf_token(request: Request) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The token every console form carries as a hidden `csrf_token` field.\"\"\"\n    token = request.session.get(\"csrf\")\n    if not token:\n        token = request.session[\"csrf\"] = secrets.token_urlsafe(32)\n    return token\n\n\nSAFE_METHODS = {\"GET\", \"HEAD\", \"OPTIONS\"}\n\n\nclass CsrfRejected(Exception):\n    \"\"\"A state-changing request whose form lacks this session's token.\"\"\"\n\n\nasync def verify_csrf(request: Request) -> None:\n    \"\"\"App-wide dependency: every POST (or other unsafe method) must carry the\n    session's CSRF token in its form, or it is refused before the route runs.\"\"\"\n    if request.method in SAFE_METHODS:\n        return\n    expected = request.session.get(\"csrf\")\n    sent = (await request.form()).get(\"csrf_token\")\n    if not expected or not isinstance(sent, str) or not secrets.compare_digest(sent, expected):\n        raise CsrfRejected\n\n\nasync def csrf_rejected_handler(request: Request, exc: Exception) -> PlainTextResponse:\n    return PlainTextResponse(\"请求已过期或来源不明，请返回刷新页面后重试。\",\n                             status_code=403)\n\n\ndef form_text(form: FormData, name: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"A form field as text. A missing one (or a file) counts as blank, so it\n    gets the console's message rather than a 422.\"\"\"\n    value = form.get(name)\n    return value if isinstance(value, str) else \"\"\n\n\n_LARGEST_ID = 2 ** 63 - 1  # SQLite's largest integer\n\n\ndef id_or_none(value: str) -> int | None:\n    \"\"\"A form's or query's id field as a number, or None if it holds anything\n    but ASCII digits or a number too large to be an id.\"\"\"\n    value = value.strip()\n    if not (value.isascii() and value.isdigit()):\n        return None\n    number = int(value)\n    return number if number <= _LARGEST_ID else None\n\n\ndef flash(request: Request, message: str, kind: str = \"success\") -> None:\n    \"\"\"Queue a message for the next page shown. kind: success | notice | error.\"\"\"\n    request.session.setdefault(\"flash\", []).append([kind, message])\n\n\ndef pop_flashes(request: Request) -> list[list[str]]:\n    return request.session.pop(\"flash\", [])\n\n\ndef console_root(request: Request) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The relative path from this page back to the console root (\"\" at\n    /login, \"../\" at /admin/guides, \"../../../\" at /admin/guides/5/edit).\n    Templates put it in front of every console link, so no link is\n    root-absolute and none depends on which route rendered the page. A\n    mount prefix (root_path) is part of the console root, so it is not\n    climbed out of.\"\"\"\n    path = request.url.path.removeprefix(request.scope.get(\"root_path\", \"\"))\n    return \"../\" * (path.count(\"/\") - 1)\n\n\ntemplates.env.globals[\"csrf_token\"] = csrf_token\ntemplates.env.globals[\"pop_flashes\"] = pop_flashes\ntemplates.env.globals[\"console_root\"] = console_root\ntemplates.env.globals[\"submission_banned\"] = accounts.SUBMISSION_BANNED\ntemplates.env.globals[\"min_password_length\"] = accounts.MIN_PASSWORD_LENGTH\n\n\ndef start_session(request: Request, session_id: str) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Replace the cookie's contents, so nothing from before login survives\n    (the CSRF token is reissued on the next page).\"\"\"\n    request.session.clear()\n    request.session[\"sid\"] = session_id\n\n\nclass LoginRequired(Exception):\n    \"\"\"Raised when nobody is signed in; answered with a redirect to /login.\"\"\"\n\n\nclass SetupRequired(Exception):\n    \"\"\"Raised when the user still has first-login setup to do; answered with a\n    redirect to /admin/setup.\"\"\"\n\n\ndef signed_in_user_mid_setup(request: Request) -> accounts.User:\n    \"\"\"Dependency for the setup page only: the signed-in user, whether or not\n    they have finished first-login setup.\"\"\"\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        user = accounts.user_for_session(conn, request.session.get(\"sid\"))\n    if user is None:\n        raise LoginRequired\n    return user\n\n\ndef signed_in_user(request: Request) -> accounts.User:\n    \"\"\"Dependency for every other console page: the signed-in user, who has\n    finished first-login setup. Anyone else is redirected.\"\"\"\n    user = signed_in_user_mid_setup(request)\n    if user.needs_setup:\n        raise SetupRequired\n    return user\n\n\nclass AdminRequired(Exception):\n    \"\"\"Raised when an Editor reaches an Admin-only page; answered with a 403\n    console page, which keeps the navigation for the signed-in `user`.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self, user: accounts.User) -> None:\n        super().__init__()\n        self.user = user\n\n\n# Every guard made by requires(), so a test can find every route behind one.\nADMIN_GUARDS: set[Callable[..., accounts.User]] = set()\n\n\ndef requires(capability: str) -> Callable[..., accounts.User]:\n    \"\"\"A dependency for Admin-only pages: the signed-in user, if they have\n    `capability`. Anyone else is refused, whether they followed a link or\n    typed the URL. Make one per capability at import time, so FastAPI's\n    per-request cache recognises it.\"\"\"\n    def guard(user: Annotated[accounts.User, Depends(signed_in_user)]) -> accounts.User:\n        if not user.can(capability):\n            raise AdminRequired(user)\n        return user\n    ADMIN_GUARDS.add(guard)\n    return guard\n\n\nadmin_user = requires(\"manage_game\")\n\n\ndef home_for(user: accounts.User) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Where a signed-in user belongs: setup first, then the dashboard.\"\"\"\n    return \"/admin/setup\" if user.needs_setup else \"/admin/dashboard\"\n\n\ndef redirect(url: str) -> RedirectResponse:\n    return RedirectResponse(url, status_code=303)\n\n\nasync def login_required_handler(request: Request, exc: Exception) -> RedirectResponse:\n    return redirect(\"/login\")\n\n\nasync def admin_required_handler(request: Request, exc: Exception) -> HTMLResponse:\n    user = exc.user if isinstance(exc, AdminRequired) else None\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(\n        request, \"admin/refused.html\", {\"title\": \"没有权限\", \"user\": user},\n        status_code=403)\n\n\nasync def setup_required_handler(request: Request, exc: Exception) -> RedirectResponse:\n    return redirect(\"/admin/setup\")\n26:from jinja2 import Environment, FileSystemLoader, select_autoescape\n70:def environment(glossary: game.Glossary) -> Environment:\n71:    env = Environment(\n76:    env.filters[\"localized\"] = lambda item, field, lang: getattr(item, f\"{field}_{lang}\")\n78:    env.filters[\"markdown\"] = lambda text, lang: render_markdown(text, lang, glossary).html\n100:class _Writer:\n136:def render_site(out: Path | None = None) -> Path:\n152:    write = _Writer(out, current_patch=patches[0].name if patches else Every href and src is RELATIVE (\"../../style.css\"), never root-absolute\n     (\"/style.css\"), because Pages serves this from a subfolder.\n\nA Site build (the console's 更新网站 button) is render_site() followed by\ndeploy(), which pushes site/ to the gh-pages branch. Only a build whose deploy\nsucceeded is recorded, and the dashboard counts the changes since then.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport itertools\nimport posixpath\nimport shutil\nimport sqlite3\nimport subprocess\nimport sys\nfrom pathlib import Path\nfrom typing import Any\n\nfrom jinja2 import Environment, FileSystemLoader, select_autoescape\n\nfrom app import content, db, game, guides, settings\nfrom app.rendering import render_markdown\n\nCSS = \"\"\"/* Minimal starter styles — make them yours. */\n:root { color-scheme: light dark; }\nbody { font: 16px/1.6 system-ui, \"PingFang SC\", \"Microsoft YaHei\", sans-serif;\n       margin: 0 auto; max-width: 42rem; padding: 1rem; }\nheader { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: .5rem 1rem; align-items: baseline; }\nheader .brand { font-weight: 700; text-decoration: none; margin-inline-end: auto; }\n.site-nav { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: .25rem 1rem; flex-basis: 100%; }\nmain { margin-block: 2rem; }\n.badge { display: inline-block; padding: 0 .5rem; border-radius: 1rem;\n         border: 1px solid; font-size: .85em; }\n.term { font-weight: 600; }\n.fallback-notice { display: none; }\n.fallback-notice:target { display: block; }\n\"\"\"\n\nLANGUAGES = (\"zh\", \"en\")\n\n# The words on the public site, in each language.\nLABELS = {\n    \"zh\": {\"site_name\": \"大巴扎攻略站\", \"current_patch\": \"当前版本：\",\n           \"newest_guides\": \"最新攻略\", \"heroes\": \"英雄\", \"no_guides\": \"还没有攻略。\",\n           \"updated\": \"更新于\", \"guides\": \"攻略\", \"tournaments\": \"锦标赛\",\n           \"announcement\": \"预告\", \"recap\": \"回顾\", \"tournament_date\": \"比赛日期\",\n           \"no_tournament_items\": \"还没有锦标赛内容。\", \"follows\": \"对应的预告：\",\n           \"other_language\": \"English\"},\n    \"en\": {\"site_name\": \"The Bazaar Guides\", \"current_patch\": \"Current Patch: \",\n           \"newest_guides\": \"Newest guides\", \"heroes\": \"Heroes\",\n           \"no_guides\": \"No English guides yet.\", \"updated\": \"Updated\",\n           \"guides\": \"Guides\", \"tournaments\": \"Tournaments\",\n           \"announcement\": \"Announcement\", \"recap\": \"Recap\",\n           \"tournament_date\": \"Tournament date\",\n           \"no_tournament_items\": \"No English tournament posts yet.\",\n           \"follows\": \"Announcement: \",\n           \"other_language\": \"中文\"},\n}\nNEWEST_ON_HOME = 10\nNO_ENGLISH_TEXT = \"no-english-text\"  # the id of the fallback notice\n\n\ndef environment(glossary: game.Glossary) -> Environment:\n    env = Environment(\n        loader=FileSystemLoader(str(settings.TEMPLATES)),\n        autoescape=select_autoescape([\"html\"]),\n    )\n    # `guide|localized(\"title\", lang)` is guide.title_zh or guide.title_en.\n    env.filters[\"localized\"] = lambda item, field, lang: getattr(item, f\"{field}_{lang}\")\n    # `text|markdown(lang)`: sanitized HTML, with Game Terms in `lang`.\n    env.filters[\"markdown\"] = lambda text, lang: render_markdown(text, lang, glossary).html\n    return env\n\n\ndef by_patch(listed: list[guides.Guide]) -> list[tuple[str, list[guides.Guide]]]:\n    \"\"\"Guides grouped by Patch, newest Patch first, keeping each group's order.\"\"\"\n    ordered = sorted(listed, key=lambda guide: guide.patch_id, reverse=True)\n    return [(patch_name, list(group)) for patch_name, group\n            in itertools.groupby(ordered, key=lambda guide: guide.patch_name)]\n\n\ndef relative(target: str, page: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The relative link from the page at folder `page` to `target`. Both are\n    paths from the site root; a folder ends in \"/\" (\"\" is the root itself).\n    `target` may end in a \"#fragment\".\"\"\"\n    target, hash_mark, fragment = target.partition(\"#\")\n    link = posixpath.relpath(target or \".\", page or \".\")\n    if target.endswith(\"/\") or not target:\n        link += \"/\"\n    return f\"{link}{hash_mark}{fragment}\"\n\n\nclass _Writer:\n    \"\"\"Writes pages into `out`. Each page can make relative links with\n    `site_link(path from the root)` and, inside a language tree, with\n    `link(path inside the tree)`. A page in a language tree also gets\n    `switch_link`, the language switch: the same page in the `other` tree\n    unless `switch_to` names another path inside that tree, and `nav_pages`,\n    the Published Pages in the navigation of that tree.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self, out: Path, current_patch: str | None,\n                 glossary: game.Glossary, nav_pages: list[content.Page]) -> None:\n        self.out = out\n        self.env = environment(glossary)\n        self.current_patch = current_patch\n        self.nav_pages = {lang: [page for page in nav_pages if page.has_text_in(lang)]\n                          for lang in LANGUAGES}\n\n    def page(self, path: str, template: str, *, lang: str | None = None,\n             switch_to: str | None = None, **context: Any) -> None:\n        \"\"\"Write the page Readers get at `path`: \"\" for the root, or a folder\n        such as \"zh/guides/vanessa-12/\".\"\"\"\n        def site_link(target: str) -> str:\n            return relative(target, path)\n\n        if lang:\n            other = \"en\" if lang == \"zh\" else \"zh\"\n            same_page = path.removeprefix(f\"{lang}/\")\n            context |= {\"lang\": lang, \"other\": other, \"t\": LABELS[lang],\n                        \"link\": lambda target: site_link(f\"{lang}/{target}\"),\n                        \"switch_link\": site_link(f\"{other}/{switch_to or same_page}\"),\n                        \"nav_pages\": self.nav_pages[lang]}\n        file = self.out / path / \"index.html\"\n        file.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n        file.write_text(self.env.get_template(template).render(\n            site_link=site_link, current_patch=self.current_patch, **context))\n\n\ndef render_site(out: Path | None = None) -> Path:\n    out = out or settings.SITE\n    if out.exists():\n        shutil.rmtree(out)\n    out.mkdir(parents=True)\n\"\"\"Shared test fixtures.\n\n`client` Passwords come from the environment there; in\n# tests they are fixed and meaningless.\nDEMO_USERS = {\n    \"admin\": {\"email\": \"admin@example.test\", \"password\": \"test-admin-pw\",\n              \"display_name\": \"演示管理员\"},\n    \"editor\": {\"email\": \"editor@example.test\", \"password\": \"test-editor-pw\",\n               \"display_name\": \"演示编辑\"},\n}\n\n\n@pytest.fixture(autouse=True)\ndef database(tmp_path, monkeypatch):\n    \"\"\"A fresh database per test, seeded with DEMO_USERS.\"\"\"\n    from app import accounts, db\n\n    monkeypatch.setenv(\"CMS_DATABASE\", str(tmp_path / \"cms.db\"))\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        for role, user in DEMO_USERS.items():\n            accounts.create_user(conn, email=user[\"email\"],\n                                 password=user[\"password\"], role=role,\n                                 display_name=user[\"display_name\"])\n    return tmp_path / \"cms.db\"\n\n\n@pytest.fixture(autouse=True)\ndef deploys(tmp_path, monkeypatch) -> list[Path]:\n    \"\"\"The folders the Site build deployed, in order. {"parentUuid":"6a00accf-f24e-47af-9211-4091c74a8e5f","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"92f2c8fb-e9e7-4ccf-b4e2-f36839dbe2c5","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"type":"text","text":"Base directory for this skill: /Users/yining/.claude/plugins/cache/claude-plugins-official/mattpocock-skills/1.3.1/skills/engineering/tdd\n\n# Test-Driven Development\n\nTDD is the red → green loop. This skill is the reference that makes that loop produce tests worth keeping: what a good test is, where tests go, the anti-patterns, and the rules of the loop. Every section applies on every cycle: consult them before and during the loop, not after.\n\nWhen exploring the codebase, read `GLOSSARY.md` (if it exists) so test names and interface vocabulary match the project's domain language, and respect ADRs in the area you're touching.\n\n## What a good test is\n\nTests verify behavior through public interfaces, not implementation details. Code can change entirely; tests shouldn't. A good test reads like a specification: \"user can checkout with valid cart\" tells you exactly what capability exists, and it survives refactors because it doesn't care about internal structure.\n\nSee [tests.md](tests.md) for examples and [mocking.md](mocking.md) for mocking guidelines.\n\n## Seams: where tests go\n\nA **seam** is the public boundary you test at: the interface where you observe behavior without reaching inside. Tests live at seams, never against internals.\n\n**Test only at pre-agreed seams.** Before writing any test, write down the seams under test and confirm them with the user. No test is written at an unconfirmed seam. You can't test everything, so agreeing the seams up front is how testing effort lands on the critical paths and complex logic instead of every edge case.\n\nAsk: \"What's the public interface, and which seams should we test?\" Give each proposed seam a one-line note on what it catches and what it misses.\n\nWhen the shape of that interface is itself in question (how deep the module is, where the seam belongs, what the interface should expose), call the Skill tool with \"codebase-design\" for the vocabulary. It is the shared source of the module, interface, depth, seam, adapter, leverage and locality terms, and it is a reference to consult, not a session to run.\n\n## Anti-patterns\n\n- **Implementation-coupled**: mocks internal collaborators, tests private methods, or verifies through a side channel (querying the database instead of using the interface). The tell: the test breaks when you refactor but behavior hasn't changed.\n- **Tautological**: the assertion recomputes the expected value the way the code does (`expect(add(a, b)).toBe(a + b)`, a snapshot derived by hand the same way, a constant asserted equal to itself), so it passes by construction and can never disagree with the code. Expected values must come from an independent source of truth: a known-good literal, a worked example, the spec.\n- **Horizontal slicing**: writing all tests first, then all implementation. Bulk tests verify _imagined_ behavior: you test the _shape_ of things rather than user-facing behavior, the tests go insensitive to real changes, and you commit to test structure before understanding the implementation. Work in **vertical slices** instead: one test → one implementation → repeat, each test a **tracer bullet** that responds to what the last cycle taught you.\n\n## Rules of the loop\n\n- **Red before green.** Write the failing test first, then only enough code to pass it. Don't anticipate future tests or add speculative features.\n- **One slice at a time.** One seam, one test, one minimal implementation per cycle.\n- **Refactoring is not part of the loop.** It belongs to the review stage (see the `code-review` skill), not the red → green implementation cycle.\n"}]},"isMeta":true,"turnCompanion":true,"uuid":"7447656d-2740-47ab-be58-c144ae918d03","timestamp":"2026-10-18T03:37:42.872Z","sourceToolUseID":"toolu_0184HuBV4qJ4aGvZJ7pZvKL4","session_id":"12c6389f-50bb-452b-bb07-f08bd624cfd6","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/yining/orca/workspaces/iphs400-mp2-cms/IPHS400-Mini-Project-2","sessionId":"12c6389f-50bb-452b-bb07-f08bd624cfd6","version":"2.1.302","gitBranch":"Avulpix0412/IPHS400-Mini-Project-2"}

{"type":"api-request-blob","sessionId":"12c6389f-50bb-452b-bb07-f08bd624cfd6","hash":"d0e86b8b96aded9f220e03a6294a6ea02af7bcbddb770a9ece1ae3088fd0bd0a","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01EJttbeYd9AQfShopvW8yZZ","type":"tool_result","content":"\"\"\"The Site build: render everything Published into site/ as plain HTML.\n\nThe site has a Chinese tree (zh/) and an English tree (en/), and every page is\nan index.html in its own folder, so its address is the folder (`zh/guides/\nvanessa-12/`). Two rules the rubric checks:\n\n  1. Only PUBLISHED content is read here. A Draft that reaches site/ is a bug.\n  2. Every href and src is RELATIVE (\"../../style.css\"), never root-absolute\n     (\"/style.css\"), because Pages serves this from a subfolder.\n\nA Site build (the console's 更新网站 button) is render_site() followed by\ndeploy(), which pushes site/ to the gh-pages branch. Only a build whose deploy\nsucceeded is recorded, and the dashboard counts the changes since then.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport itertools\nimport posixpath\nimport shutil\nimport sqlite3\nimport subprocess\nimport sys\nfrom pathlib import Path\nfrom typing import Any\n\nfrom jinja2 import Environment, FileSystemLoader, select_autoescape\n\nfrom app import content, db, game, guides, settings\nfrom app.rendering import render_markdown\n\nCSS = \"\"\"/* Minimal starter styles — make them yours. */\n:root { color-scheme: light dark; }\nbody { font: 16px/1.6 system-ui, \"PingFang SC\", \"Microsoft YaHei\", sans-serif;\n       margin: 0 auto; max-width: 42rem; padding: 1rem; }\nheader { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: .5rem 1rem; align-items: baseline; }\nheader .brand { font-weight: 700; text-decoration: none; margin-inline-end: auto; }\n.site-nav { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: .25rem 1rem; flex-basis: 100%; }\nmain { margin-block: 2rem; }\n.badge { display: inline-block; padding: 0 .5rem; border-radius: 1rem;\n         border: 1px solid; font-size: .85em; }\n.term { font-weight: 600; }\n.fallback-notice { display: none; }\n.fallback-notice:target { display: block; }\n\"\"\"\n\nLANGUAGES = (\"zh\", \"en\")\n\n# The words on the public site, in each language.\nLABELS = {\n    \"zh\": {\"site_name\": \"大巴扎攻略站\", \"current_patch\": \"当前版本：\",\n           \"newest_guides\": \"最新攻略\", \"heroes\": \"英雄\", \"no_guides\": \"还没有攻略。\",\n           \"updated\": \"更新于\", \"guides\": \"攻略\", \"tournaments\": \"锦标赛\",\n           \"announcement\": \"预告\", \"recap\": \"回顾\", \"tournament_date\": \"比赛日期\",\n           \"no_tournament_items\": \"还没有锦标赛内容。\", \"follows\": \"对应的预告：\",\n           \"other_language\": \"English\"},\n    \"en\": {\"site_name\": \"The Bazaar Guides\", \"current_patch\": \"Current Patch: \",\n           \"newest_guides\": \"Newest guides\", \"heroes\": \"Heroes\",\n           \"no_guides\": \"No English guides yet.\", \"updated\": \"Updated\",\n           \"guides\": \"Guides\", \"tournaments\": \"Tournaments\",\n           \"announcement\": \"Announcement\", \"recap\": \"Recap\",\n           \"tournament_date\": \"Tournament date\",\n           \"no_tournament_items\": \"No English tournament posts yet.\",\n           \"follows\": \"Announcement: \",\n           \"other_language\": \"中文\"},\n}\nNEWEST_ON_HOME = 10\nNO_ENGLISH_TEXT = \"no-english-text\"  # the id of the fallback notice\n\n\ndef environment(glossary: game.Glossary) -> Environment:\n    env = Environment(\n        loader=FileSystemLoader(str(settings.TEMPLATES)),\n        autoescape=select_autoescape([\"html\"]),\n    )\n    # `guide|localized(\"title\", lang)` is guide.title_zh or guide.title_en.\n    env.filters[\"localized\"] = lambda item, field, lang: getattr(item, f\"{field}_{lang}\")\n    # `text|markdown(lang)`: sanitized HTML, with Game Terms in `lang`.\n    env.filters[\"markdown\"] = lambda text, lang: render_markdown(text, lang, glossary).html\n    return env\n\n\ndef by_patch(listed: list[guides.Guide]) -> list[tuple[str, list[guides.Guide]]]:\n    \"\"\"Guides grouped by Patch, newest Patch first, keeping each group's order.\"\"\"\n    ordered = sorted(listed, key=lambda guide: guide.patch_id, reverse=True)\n    return [(patch_name, list(group)) for patch_name, group\n            in itertools.groupby(ordered, key=lambda guide: guide.patch_name)]\n\n\ndef relative(target: str, page: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The relative link from the page at folder `page` to `target`. Both are\n    paths from the site root; a folder ends in \"/\" (\"\" is the root itself).\n    `target` may end in a \"#fragment\".\"\"\"\n    target, hash_mark, fragment = target.partition(\"#\")\n    link = posixpath.relpath(target or \".\", page or \".\")\n    if target.endswith(\"/\") or not target:\n        link += \"/\"\n    return f\"{link}{hash_mark}{fragment}\"\n\n\nclass _Writer:\n    \"\"\"Writes pages into `out`. Each page can make relative links with\n    `site_link(path from the root)` and, inside a language tree, with\n    `link(path inside the tree)`. A page in a language tree also gets\n    `switch_link`, the language switch: the same page in the `other` tree\n    unless `switch_to` names another path inside that tree, and `nav_pages`,\n    the Published Pages in the navigation of that tree.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self, out: Path, current_patch: str | None,\n                 glossary: game.Glossary, nav_pages: list[content.Page]) -> None:\n        self.out = out\n        self.env = environment(glossary)\n        self.current_patch = current_patch\n        self.nav_pages = {lang: [page for page in nav_pages if page.has_text_in(lang)]\n                          for lang in LANGUAGES}\n\n    def page(self, path: str, template: str, *, lang: str | None = None,\n             switch_to: str | None = None, **context: Any) -> None:\n        \"\"\"Write the page Readers get at `path`: \"\" for the root, or a folder\n        such as \"zh/guides/vanessa-12/\".\"\"\"\n        def site_link(target: str) -> str:\n            return relative(target, path)\n\n        if lang:\n            other = \"en\" if lang == \"zh\" else \"zh\"\n            same_page = path.removeprefix(f\"{lang}/\")\n            context |= {\"lang\": lang, \"other\": other, \"t\": LABELS[lang],\n                        \"link\": lambda target: site_link(f\"{lang}/{target}\"),\n                        \"switch_link\": site_link(f\"{other}/{switch_to or same_page}\"),\n                        \"nav_pages\": self.nav_pages[lang]}\n        file = self.out / path / \"index.html\"\n        file.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n        file.write_text(self.env.get_template(template).render(\n            site_link=site_link, current_patch=self.current_patch, **context))\n\n\ndef render_site(out: Path | None = None) -> Path:\n    out = out or settings.SITE\n    if out.exists():\n        shutil.rmtree(out)\n    out.mkdir(parents=True)\n\"\"\"Shared test fixtures.\n\n`client` gives you the app. `client_as(role)` gives you a client that is logged\nin as a seeded user of that role, so access-control tests stay one line:\n\n    def test_editor_cannot_manage_users(client_as):\n        assert client_as(\"editor\").get(\"/admin/users\").status_code in (302, 403)\n\nEvery test gets its own empty SQLite database (through `CMS_DATABASE`) holding\nonly the DEMO_USERS below. The Site build writes into a temporary folder, and\nits deploy step is replaced, so no test ever pushes to gh-pages.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\n\nimport pytest\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nfrom fastapi.testclient import TestClient\n\nfrom app.main import create_app\n\n# Matches scripts/seed_demo.py. Passwords come from the environment there; in\n# tests they are fixed and meaningless.\nDEMO_USERS = {\n    \"admin\": {\"email\": \"admin@example.test\", \"password\": \"test-admin-pw\",\n              \"display_name\": \"演示管理员\"},\n    \"editor\": {\"email\": \"editor@example.test\", \"password\": \"test-editor-pw\",\n               \"display_name\": \"演示编辑\"},\n}\n\n\n@pytest.fixture(autouse=True)\ndef database(tmp_path, monkeypatch):\n    \"\"\"A fresh database per test, seeded with DEMO_USERS.\"\"\"\n    from app import accounts, db\n\n    monkeypatch.setenv(\"CMS_DATABASE\", str(tmp_path / \"cms.db\"))\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        for role, user in DEMO_USERS.items():\n            accounts.create_user(conn, email=user[\"email\"],\n                                 password=user[\"password\"], role=role,\n                                 display_name=user[\"display_name\"])\n    return tmp_path / \"cms.db\"\n\n\n@pytest.fixture(autouse=True)\ndef deploys(tmp_path, monkeypatch) -> list[Path]:\n    \"\"\"The folders the Site build deployed, in order. A test can replace\n    `app.publish.deploy` again to make the push fail.\"\"\"\n    from app import publish, settings\n\n    monkeypatch.setattr(settings, \"SITE\", tmp_path / \"site\")\n    pushed: list[Path] = []\n    monkeypatch.setattr(publish, \"deploy\", lambda out, *_: pushed.append(out))\n    return pushed\n\n\ndef add_user(**fields) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Arrange an extra account directly, in any state, with its setup done\n    (quicker than making it on the Users page, which T09's tests do).\"\"\"\n    from app import accounts, db\n\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        accounts.create_user(conn, **fields)\n\n\ndef csrf_token(page_html: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Pull the CSRF token out of a rendered console form.\"\"\"\n    match = re.search(r'name=\"csrf_token\" value=\"([^\"]+)\"', page_html)\n    assert match, \"page has no CSRF token\"\n    return match.group(1)\n\n\ndef login(c: TestClient, email: str, password: str):\n    \"\"\"Submit the login form the way a browser does, token included.\"\"\"\n    token = csrf_token(c.get(\"/login\").text)\n    return c.post(\"/login\", data={\"email\": email, \"password\": password,\n                                  \"csrf_token\": token},","is_error":false},{"type":"tool_result","tool_use_id":"toolu_0184HuBV4qJ4aGvZJ7pZvKL4","content":"Launching skill: mattpocock-skills:tdd"},{"type":"text","text":"Base directory for this skill: /Users/yining/.claude/plugins/cache/claude-plugins-official/mattpocock-skills/1.3.1/skills/engineering/tdd\n\n# Test-Driven Development\n\nTDD is the red → green loop. This skill is the reference that makes that loop produce tests worth keeping: what a good test is, where tests go, the anti-patterns, and the rules of the loop. Every section applies on every cycle: consult them before and during the loop, not after.\n\nWhen exploring the codebase, read `GLOSSARY.md` (if it exists) so test names and interface vocabulary match the project's domain language, and respect ADRs in the area you're touching.\n\n## What a good test is\n\nTests verify behavior through public interfaces, not implementation details. Code can change entirely; tests shouldn't. A good test reads like a specification: \"user can checkout with valid cart\" tells you exactly what capability exists, and it survives refactors because it doesn't care about internal structure.\n\nSee [tests.md](tests.md) for examples and [mocking.md](mocking.md) for mocking guidelines.\n\n## Seams: where tests go\n\nA **seam** is the public boundary you test at: the interface where you observe behavior without reaching inside. Tests live at seams, never against internals.\n\n**Test only at pre-agreed seams.** Before writing any test, write down the seams under test and confirm them with the user. No test is written at an unconfirmed seam. You can't test everything, so agreeing the seams up front is how testing effort lands on the critical paths and complex logic instead of every edge case.\n\nAsk: \"What's the public interface, and which seams should we test?\" Give each proposed seam a one-line note on what it catches and what it misses.\n\nWhen the shape of that interface is itself in question (how deep the module is, where the seam belongs, what the interface should expose), call the Skill tool with \"codebase-design\" for the vocabulary. It is the shared source of the module, interface, depth, seam, adapter, leverage and locality terms, and it is a reference to consult, not a session to run.\n\n## Anti-patterns\n\n- **Implementation-coupled**: mocks internal collaborators, tests private methods, or verifies through a side channel (querying the database instead of using the interface). The tell: the test breaks when you refactor but behavior hasn't changed.\n- **Tautological**: the assertion recomputes the expected value the way the code does (`expect(add(a, b)).toBe(a + b)`, a snapshot derived by hand the same way, a constant asserted equal to itself), so it passes by construction and can never disagree with the code. Expected values must come from an independent source of truth: a known-good literal, a worked example, the spec.\n- **Horizontal slicing**: writing all tests first, then all implementation. Bulk tests verify _imagined_ behavior: you test the _shape_ of things rather than user-facing behavior, the tests go insensitive to real changes, and you commit to test structure before understanding the implementation. Work in **vertical slices** instead: one test → one implementation → repeat, each test a **tracer bullet** that responds to what the last cycle taught you.\n\n## Rules of the loop\n\n- **Red before green.** Write the failing test first, then only enough code to pass it. Don't anticipate future tests or add speculative features.\n- **One slice at a time.** One seam, one test, one minimal implementation per cycle.\n- **Refactoring is not part of the loop.** It belongs to the review stage (see the `code-review` skill), not the red → green implementation cycle.\n"}]}}

Now the module:"},{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01JPqjc5dXBmKBL6LfuR2Fw7","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/Users/yining/orca/workspaces/iphs400-mp2-cms/IPHS400-Mini-Project-2/app/times.py","content":"\"\"\"Showing stored times in Beijing time.\n\nEvery time is stored in UTC, as SQLite writes it (\"2026-10-17 13:05:42.123\",\nor without the milliseconds for CURRENT_TIMESTAMP columns), and compared as\nstored: the dashboard's \"changes not yet on the site\" count depends on that.\nOnly what the console and the site show is converted, by these two functions,\nwhich both template environments register as filters (`|beijing_time`,\n`|beijing_date`), so no page prints a stored time as it is.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom datetime import UTC, datetime, timedelta, timezone\n\n# Asia/Shanghai. China has kept UTC+8 all year since 1991, so a fixed offset\n# gives the same times without needing the tz database (absent on Windows).\nBEIJING = timezone(timedelta(hours=8), \"北京时间\")\n\n\ndef _in_beijing(stored: str) -> datetime:\n    return datetime.fromisoformat(stored).replace(tzinfo=UTC).astimezone(BEIJING)\n\n\ndef beijing_time(stored: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"A stored UTC time as Beijing time to the minute: \"2026-10-17 21:05\".\"\"\"\n    return _in_beijing(stored).strftime(\"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M\")\n\n\ndef beijing_date(stored: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The Beijing date of a stored UTC time: \"2026-10-18\" for 17:30 UTC on\n    the 17th.\"\"\"\n    return _in_beijing(stored).strftime(\"%Y-%m-%d\")\n\n\nFILTERS = {\"beijing_time\": beijing_time, \"beijing_date\": beijing_date}\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}},{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01VTjBfKnn39WRTG7ZrY2Pjm","name":"Bash","input":{"command":"uv run pytest -q tests/test_25_beijing_time.py 2>&1 | tail -3","description":"Run unit tests for conversion"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}]}}

assert page.status_code == 200\n    assert \"草稿已保存\" in page.text\n    assert 'value=\"瓦妮莎海盗流\"' in page.text and \"先拿船，再拿炮。\" in page.text\n\n    response = save(editor, edit_page, passed, 1 warning in 1.90s\n{% extends \"admin/base.html\" %}\n{% block content %}\n  <h1>回收站</h1>\n  <p>被删除的攻略在这里，只有管理员能看到，也不会出现在公开网站上。恢复后，攻略会原样回到作者手里。</p>\n  <table>\n    <thead><tr><th>标题</th><th>作者</th><th>状态</th><th>删除于</th><th></th></tr></thead>\n    <tbody>\n    {% for guide in guides %}\n      <tr>\n        <td>{{ guide.title_zh or \"（无标题）\" }}</td>\n        <td>{{ guide.author_name }}</td>\n        <td>{{ guide.status_label }}</td>\n        <td>{{ guide.trashed_at|beijing_time }}</td>\n        <td>\n          <form method=\"post\" action=\"{{ console_root(request) }}admin/trash/{{ guide.id }}/restore\">\n            <input type=\"hidden\" name=\"csrf_token\" value=\"{{ csrf_token(request) }}\">\n            <button type=\"submit\">恢复</button>\n            <a href=\"{{ console_root(request) }}admin/trash/{{ guide.id }}/delete\">彻底删除…</a>\n          </form>\n        </td>\n      </tr>\n    {% else %}\n      <tr><td colspan=\"5\">回收站是空的。</td></tr>\n    {% endfor %}\n    </tbody>\n  </table>\n{% endblock %}\n{% extends \"admin/base.html\" %}\n{% block content %}\n  <h1>用户</h1>\n  <p>登录邮箱只在这里显示，不会出现在公开网站上。被禁止投稿或已停用的用户，已发布的攻略仍然留在网站上。</p>\n  <div class=\"scroll\">\n  <table>\n    <thead><tr><th>昵称</th><th>登录邮箱</th><th>角色</th><th>状态</th><th>攻略</th><th>上次登录</th></tr></thead>\n    <tbody>\n    {% for account in users %}\n      {% set guide_counts = counts.get(account.id, no_guides) %}\n      <tr>\n        <td><a href=\"{{ console_root(request) }}admin/users/{{ account.id }}\">{{ account.display_name or \"（未完成首次登录设置）\" }}</a></td>\n        <td>{{ account.email }}</td>\n        <td>{{ roles[account.role] }}</td>\n        <td>{{ states[account.state] }}{% if account.needs_setup %}（待首次登录设置）{% endif %}</td>\n        <td>已发布 {{ guide_counts.published }} · 共 {{ guide_counts.total }}</td>\n        <td>{{ account.last_login_at[:16] if account.last_login_at else \"从未登录\" }}</td>\n      </tr>\n    {% endfor %}\n    </tbody>\n  </table>\n  </div>\n\n  <h2>添加账号</h2>\n  <p>对方用临时密码登录后，必须先设置自己的密码和昵称，才能使用管理后台。</p>\n  <form method=\"post\" action=\"{{ console_root(request) }}admin/users\">\n    <input type=\"hidden\" name=\"csrf_token\" value=\"{{ csrf_token(request) }}\">\n    <label>登录邮箱\n      <input type=\"email\" name=\"email\" value=\"{{ new_account.email }}\" required>\n    </label>\n    <label>角色\n      <select name=\"role\">\n        {% for role, label in roles.items() %}\n        <option value=\"{{ role }}\"{% if role == new_account.role %} selected{% endif %}>{{ label }}</option>\n        {% endfor %}\n      </select>\n    </label>\n    <label>临时密码（至少 {{ min_password_length }} 个字符）\n      <input type=\"text\" name=\"temporary_password\" required minlength=\"{{ min_password_length }}\" autocomplete=\"off\">\n    </label>\n    <button type=\"submit\">添加账号</button>\n  </form>\n{% endblock %}\ndef test_the_users_page_lists_every_account_with_role_state_guide_counts_and_last_login(\n        admin, editor):\n    published_guide(editor, admin)\n    new_guide(editor)\n    delete(editor, new_guide(editor))  # a Guide in the Trash isn't counted\n\n    admin_row = user_row(admin, DEMO_USERS[\"admin\"][\"email\"])\n    assert \"演示管理员\" in admin_row and \"管理员\" in admin_row\n    assert \"正常\" in admin_row\n    assert re.search(r\"\\d{4}-\\d{2}-\\d{2} \\d{2}:\\d{2}\", admin_row)  # last login\n\n    editor_row = user_row(admin, DEMO_USERS[\"editor\"][\"email\"])\n    assert \"演示编辑\" Every time\nthe console or the site shows is in Beijing time, to the minute\n(`2026-10-17 21:05`), or as a Beijing date on the site. Times are stored in\nUTC and compared as stored; only what is shown is converted.\n_Avoid_: local time, server time\n\n## Flagged ambiguities","originalFile":"# The Bazaar Guide Site (大巴扎攻略站)\n\nA small CMS where streamers (up主) and invited writers in the Chinese-speaking\ncommunity of the card game The Bazaar publish written guides, so players can\nfind a build for a given hero and patch without scrubbing through videos.\n\n## Language\n\n### People\n\n**Admin** (管理员):\nOne of the few top streamers who run the site. Reviews and publishes other\npeople's Guides and manages users.\n_Avoid_: owner, superuser\n\n**Editor** (编辑):\nAn invited guide writer (another up主 or an experienced player). Writes\nGuides but cannot publish them or manage users.\n_Avoid_: author (as a role name), contributor, writer\n\n**Reader** (读者):\nAnyone who plays the game and reads the public site. Has no account.\n_Avoid_: user, visitor, member\n\n**Author** (作者):\nThe Admin or Editor who wrote a Guide. Readers can browse all of an Author's\nPublished Guides on that Author's page.\n_Avoid_: owner, creator, up主 (not every Author is a streamer)\n\n**Submission ban** (禁止投稿):\nAn account state in which an Editor can still log in and work on Drafts but\ncannot Submit Guides or Revisions. Their Published Guides stay on the site.\n_Avoid_: suspension, block, mute\n\n**Deactivated** (已停用):\nAn account state in which the person cannot log in at all. Their Published\nGuides stay on the site.\n_Avoid_: deleted, disabled, banned\n\n**First-login setup** (首次登录设置):\nThe step a person with a temporary password must finish before using the\nconsole: they choose their own password and their Display name.\n_Avoid_: onboarding, activation, registration\n\n**Display name** (昵称):\nThe name an Author chooses to be shown under publicly. It is never their\nlogin username.\n_Avoid_: username, handle\n\n### Content\n\n**Guide** (攻略):\nA written strategy piece about one Hero on one Patch, typically built around\nscreenshots of a lineup or deck with an explanation of how it plays. Guides\nfor tournament mode are still Guides.\n_Avoid_: article, tutorial, post\n\n**Page** (页面):\nA standalone piece of site content written by an Admin, such as About (关于),\nthat appears in the public navigation once Published, after 攻略 and 锦标赛, in\nthe order Pages were added. Its address is an Admin-set ASCII Slug. Pages are\nnever reviewed: a Page is a Draft or Published, and deleting one is for good\n(the Trash is for Guides only).\n_Avoid_: static page\n\n**Tournament announcement** (锦标赛预告):\nAn Admin-written notice about an upcoming in-game Tournament.\n_Avoid_: event, news, post\n\n**Tournament recap** (锦标赛回顾):\nAn Admin-written account of a Tournament that has already happened. It is a\nseparate item from that Tournament's announcement, which it may link to.\n_Avoid_: event, report, result\n\n**Tournament item** (锦标赛内容):\nA Tournament announcement or a Tournament recap. Each has the Tournament's\ndate and Patch. Like Pages, they are never reviewed: each is a Draft or\nPublished, and deleting one is for good. The 锦标赛 section lists them newest\nTournament date first, badged 预告 or 回顾.\n_Avoid_: event, post, news\n\n**Chinese text / English text** (中文版 / 英文版):\nThe two language versions of a Guide (or other content), each with its own\ntitle and body. Chinese is required. English is optional, and content without\nit does not appear on the English site.\n_Avoid_: translation, localization, body\n\n### The game\n\n**Game Term** (游戏术语):\nA named thing in The Bazaar that has an official Chinese name and an official\nEnglish name, stored as a pair. It is one of seven kinds: Hero, Item, Skill,\nEnchantment, Monster, Merchant, or Event.\n_Avoid_: keyword, tag, entity\n\n**Item** (物品):\nThe Game Term kind for the cards a player builds with.\n_Avoid_: card\n\n**Event** (事件):\nThe Game Term kind for an in-game event a player encounters during a run. The\nword means only this; it is never used for a Tournament.\n_Avoid_: using \"event\" for Tournaments or site activity\n\n**Hero** (英雄):\nThe Game Term for a playable character. Every Guide is about exactly one Hero.\nNo two Heroes share an English Official name (ignoring case).\n_Avoid_: character, class\n\n**Official name** (官方名称):\nThe name the game itself uses for a Game Term in a given language. The site\nonly ever shows Official names.\n_Avoid_: nickname (外号), alias, translation\n\n**Nickname** (外号):\nA name players use for a Game Term that the game itself doesn't, such as 瓦姐\nfor 瓦妮莎. Admins record them so the preview can warn a writer who uses one\nwithout a Game Term marker. The site never shows a nickname in place of an\nOfficial name.\n_Avoid_: alias, abbreviation, slang\n\n**Game Term marker** (术语标记):\n`[[瓦妮莎]]` or `[[Vanessa]]` in a Guide's text: a Game Term named by either\nOfficial name, shown on the site as its Official name in the Reader's\nlanguage. A marker that names no Game Term shows its text without the\nbrackets, and the preview warns about it.\n_Avoid_: tag, link, shortcode\n\n**Slug** (网址名):\nThe short web-address name of a Hero or a Guide. A Hero's is derived from its\nEnglish Official name (`Vanessa` → `vanessa`) when the Hero is added, and stays\nthe same when that name is later corrected. A Guide's is `<hero-slug>-<id>` (`vanessa-12`), given when the Guide\nis created; it never changes on its own (not with the title, the Hero or a\nRevision), only when an Admin edits it, so shared links keep working. No two\nHeroes, and no two Guides, share one.\n_Avoid_: URL name, permalink, handle\n\n**Patch** (版本):\nThe game version a Guide was written for, such as `6.7`. Picked by the\nwriter. It describes when the Guide was written and is not a verdict on\nwhether the Guide is out of date.\n_Avoid_: version (also used for edits to a Guide), season\n\n**Current Patch** (当前版本):\nThe Patch an Admin added most recently. Adding a Patch always makes it the\nCurrent Patch, even if its number is lower than an earlier one's.\n_Avoid_: latest version, live patch\n\n**Tournament** (锦标赛):\nAn experimental in-game mode in which many players (up to about 100) play one\ngame together until there is one champion. It is run by the game, not\norganized by players. It has its own section on the site.\n_Avoid_: event, competition, league, match\n\n### Workflow\n\n**Draft** (草稿):\nA Guide its writer has not finished yet. Only its writer and Admins can see it.\n_Avoid_: unpublished\n\n**Submitted** (待审核):\nA Guide its writer has marked finished, waiting for an Admin to review it.\n_Avoid_: pending, draft, ready\n\n**Return** (退回):\nAn Admin's decision that a Submitted Guide or Revision is not ready. It goes\nback to its writer as a Draft, with the Admin's notes. A Returned Revision\nleaves the Published Guide as it is.\n_Avoid_: reject, decline\n\n**Review note** (审核意见):\nPart of a Return: a passage quoted from the Guide together with the Admin's\nadvice on how to fix it.\n_Avoid_: comment (comments stay on Bilibili), feedback\n\n**Publish** (发布):\nAn Admin's approval of a Submitted Guide, which makes it Published. Publishing\ndoes not by itself change the public site.\n_Avoid_: approve, go live\n\n**Unpublish** (撤下):\nAn Admin taking a Published Guide off the site without deleting it. The Guide\ngoes back to its Author as a Draft, optionally with Review notes. An\nUnpublished Page or Tournament item simply becomes a Draft again.\n_Avoid_: hide, archive, take offline\n\n**Published** (已发布):\nA Guide an Admin has approved. It will appear on the public site after the\nnext Site build.\n_Avoid_: live, approved\n\n**Trash** (回收站):\nWhere deleted Guides go. Only Admins can see it, and they can restore a Guide\nfrom it or delete it for good. A Guide in the Trash is never on the site.\n_Avoid_: archive, recycle bin, deleted\n\n**Revision** (修订):\nA proposed change to a Published Guide. While it waits for review the\nPublished Guide stays on the site unchanged. Once published, it replaces the\nold content and the old content is not shown.\n_Avoid_: version, new version, edit\n\n**Site build** (更新网站):\nRegenerating the public site from everything that is Published, and putting it\nonline. This is the only step that changes what Readers see.\n_Avoid_: publish, deploy, export\n\n## Flagged ambiguities\n\n- \"Draft\" was being used for both an unfinished Guide and a finished one\n  awaiting review. Those are now **Draft** and **Submitted**.\n- \"Version\" can mean the game's Patch or an edit to a Guide. Use **Patch** for\n  the game and **Revision** for an edit.\n- \"Publish\" meant both an Admin's approval and regenerating the site. Approval\n  is **Publish**; regenerating is **Site build**. An Editor never publishes:\n  their button is Submit (提交审核).\n- \"Event\" is a Game Term kind (事件). Tournament items are announcements and\n  recaps, never \"events\".\n- \"Card\" and \"Item\" are the same thing.
