{"parentUuid":"55b6e54b-3943-413f-980c-b1d7b9862654","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-opus-5-5","id":"msg_011Cg92TAftcxfb9jfdhSxDf","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01NSAPamN9YFvZPeHYvxNWPp","name":"Bash","input":{"command":"S=/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-yining-orca-workspaces-iphs400-mp2-cms-IPHS400-Mini-Project-2/12c6389f-50bb-452b-bb07-f08bd624cfd6/scratchpad\ncat > $S/review_comment.md <<'EOF'\n## `/code-review` findings for #25, and how each was resolved\n\nReviewed the uncommitted #25 changes. 6 findings, none breaking:\n\n1. **The users-page test could fail at a minute boundary.** The Admin signs in during the `admin` fixture, before `started` reads the clock, and `started` is rounded down to the minute. **Fixed:** `started` is now a minute before the test began. That still tells Beijing time from UTC, which is 8 hours off.\n2. **Opt-in filters don't fully meet \"a new page can't show UTC by accident\".** A template could print `{{ x.published_at }}` without `|beijing_time`. **Fixed (user's choice: template scan test):** `test_no_template_prints_a_stored_time_without_converting_it` reads every template and fails on any `{{ …_at… }}` that doesn't go through `|beijing_time` or `|beijing_date`. Mutation check: putting `trashed_at[:16]` back into `trash.html` makes it fail.\n3. **The filters crashed on a missing (NULL) time.** **Fixed:** `beijing_time(None)` and `beijing_date(None)` return `\"\"`, tested in `test_a_missing_time_shows_nothing_rather_than_breaking_the_page`.\n4. **The scrolling-table test checks only the markup, not `scrollWidth`.** **Resolved by hand:** the stack has no automated browser, so the test checks that each table is inside `<div class=\"scroll\">`. With `/browse` at 390×844, `document.documentElement.scrollWidth` is **390** on the Guide list, the Trash and the dashboard, with long titles in place.\n5. **Long Guide titles were forced onto one line** (`.scroll td { white-space: nowrap }`). **Fixed:** the title cells in the Guide list, Trash and review queue use the existing `td.wrap` class.\n6. **The dashboard's review-queue table wasn't in a scrolling container.** **Fixed (user's choice: wrap it):** it's wrapped like the others and added to the scroll test.\n\n## Decisions made while building\n\n- **One conversion, two filters.** `app/times.py` has `beijing_time` (`2026-10-17 21:05`) and `beijing_date` (`2026-10-18`). Both the console and the site Jinja environments register them. Stored times and every comparison (the \"N 项更改尚未更新到网站\" count, the stale-Revision check, ordering) stay UTC.\n- **A fixed UTC+8 offset, not `zoneinfo(\"Asia/Shanghai\")`.** China has had no DST since 1991, so the times come out the same, and Windows needs no tz database (that would mean a new dependency).\n- **No \"北京时间\" label** on the times (user's choice).\n- **Testing (user's choice):** the day-crossing cases (17:30 UTC → the next Beijing date, the New Year rollover, 15:59:59.999 keeping its day) are unit tests of the conversion function. Every console page listed in the issue, plus T08's `page_edit`, `pages` and `tournament_edit`, is checked at Seam 1 against the system clock. Site dates on the home page, the Guides index, the Guide, Hero and Author pages are checked in both trees at Seam 2. The Seam 2 test can only fail on the old code between 00:00 and 08:00 Beijing time. Mutation check: setting the offset to −8 makes both the Seam 1 and Seam 2 tests fail, which shows the console and site output go through `app/times.py`.\n- **A T06 assertion changed.** `test_publishing_a_revision_replaces_the_guides_content_and_keeps_its_url` compared the shown `更新于` times (`after > before`), which relied on milliseconds. It now checks what a user sees instead: after the Revision is Published, the Guide moves above a Guide written later in the content list (most recently updated first). Mutation check: if publishing a Revision doesn't touch `updated_at`, it fails.\n- `CONTEXT.md` gains a **Beijing time (北京时间)** entry.\n\nTests: 439 passed. pyright: 0 errors.\nEOF\nrtk proxy gh issue comment 25 --body-file $S/review_comment.md","description":"Post review findings comment on issue #25"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"container":null,"stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":328,"cache_read_input_tokens":162396,"output_tokens":1599,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":328,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"global","iterations":[{"input_tokens":2,"output_tokens":1599,"cache_read_input_tokens":162396,"cache_creation_input_tokens":328,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":328},"type":"message"}],"speed":"standard","fallback_credit":null},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"wireToolInputs":{"toolu_01NSAPamN9YFvZPeHYvxNWPp":{"command":"S=/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-yining-orca-workspaces-iphs400-mp2-cms-IPHS400-Mini-Project-2/12c6389f-50bb-452b-bb07-f08bd624cfd6/scratchpad\ncat > $S/review_comment.md <<'EOF'\n## `/code-review` findings for #25, and how each was resolved\n\nReviewed the uncommitted #25 changes. 6 findings, none breaking:\n\n1. **The users-page test could fail at a minute boundary.** The Admin signs in during the `admin` fixture, before `started` reads the clock, and `started` is rounded down to the minute. **Fixed:** `started` is now a minute before the test began. With `/browse` at 390×844, `document.documentElement.scrollWidth` is **390** on the Guide list, the Trash and the dashboard, with long titles in place.\n5. **Long Guide titles were forced onto one line** (`.scroll td { white-space: nowrap }`). **Fixed:** the title cells in the Guide list, Trash and review queue use the existing `td.wrap` class.\n6. **The dashboard's review-queue table wasn't in a scrolling container.** **Fixed (user's choice: wrap it):** it's wrapped like the others and added to the scroll test.\n\n## Decisions made while building\n\n- **One conversion, two filters.** `app/times.py` has `beijing_time` (`2026-10-17 21:05`) and `beijing_date` (`2026-10-18`). Both the console and the site Jinja environments register them. Stored times and every comparison (the \"N 项更改尚未更新到网站\" count, the stale-Revision check, ordering) stay UTC.\n- **A fixed UTC+8 offset, not `zoneinfo(\"Asia/Shanghai\")`.** China has had no DST since 1991, so the times come out the same, and Windows needs no tz database (that would mean a new dependency).\n- **No \"北京时间\" label** on the times (user's choice).\n- **Testing (user's choice):** the day-crossing cases (17:30 UTC → the next Beijing date, the New Year rollover, 15:59:59.999 keeping its day) are unit tests of the conversion function. Every console page listed in the issue, plus T08's `page_edit`, `pages` and `tournament_edit`, is checked at Seam 1 against the system clock. Site dates on the home page, the Guides index, the Guide, Hero and Author pages are checked in both trees at Seam 2. The Seam 2 test can only fail on the old code between 00:00 and 08:00 Beijing time. Mutation check: setting the offset to −8 makes both the Seam 1 and Seam 2 tests fail, which shows the console and site output go through `app/times.py`.\n- **A T06 assertion changed.** `test_publishing_a_revision_replaces_the_guides_content_and_keeps_its_url` compared the shown `更新于` times (`after > before`), which relied on milliseconds. Times are still stored and compared in UTC, so the \"N 项更改尚未更新到网站\" count works as before.\n- **Every time the issue lists now shows Beijing time with no milliseconds,** plus the three T08 screens (`page_edit`, `pages`, `tournament_edit`). Use the user's domain language from `GLOSSARY.md`.\n\n### Summary\n\nPick the smallest view that makes the key point clear.\n\n- Show logic or an algorithm as pseudocode:\n\n```text\non(save)\n  if content is unchanged\n    return cached result\n  write new content\n  return fresh result\n```\n\n- Show runtime control flow as a call tree:\n\n```text\nsubmitForm\n  createSession\n    persistPrompt\n    launchAgent\n  navigateToSession\n```\n\n- Show UI structure as a component tree, including state and module boundaries that matter:\n\n```text\n<SessionPage> (apps/example/src/routes/session.tsx)\n  useSessionEvents()\n  <SessionToolbar>\n    <RunSkillButton> (packages/ui)\n```\n\n- Show file responsibility or a broad refactor as a shallow file tree:\n\n```text\nsrc/\n├── commands/       # parses user actions\n├── sessions/       # owns session state\n└── transport/      # sends API requests\n```\n\n- Show component interaction, control flow, or data flow with Mermaid:\n\n```mermaid\nsequenceDiagram\n    participant User\n    participant UI\n    participant Daemon\n    User->>UI: choose command\n    UI->>Daemon: send expanded prompt\n    Daemon-->>UI: stream result\n```\n\n- Use `diff` when the point is what changes and the surrounding shape already exists. Match the diff shape to the topic.\n\nFor a component change:\n\n```diff\n <SessionPage>\n   useSessionEvents()\n   <SessionToolbar>\n+    <RunSkillButton />\n   <SessionTimeline>\n+    <SkillResultCard />\n```\n\nFor a file-layout change:\n\n```diff\n src/\n ├── commands/\n+│   └── show-me.ts       # expands the slash command\n ├── sessions/\n-└── transport.ts\n+└── transport/\n+    ├── client.ts\n+    └── stream.ts\n```\n\nFor a call-tree or call-stack change:\n\n```diff\n submitForm\n   createSession\n     persistPrompt\n+    expandSkillMention\n     launchAgent\n-  navigateToSession\n+  navigateToSession\n+    subscribeToEvents\n```\n\nFor a state or control-flow change:\n\n```diff\n on(save)\n-  write content\n+  if content is unchanged\n+    return cached result\n+  write new content\n+  invalidate cache\n```\n\n- Show the whole block when most of it is new, when omitted context would hide ownership or order, or when the user needs a copyable target shape:\n\n```ts\nfunction expandSkill(command: string): string {\n  const skillName = command.slice(1);\n  return `use the ${skillName} skill`;\n}\n```\n\n#### Guidance\n\nPlace each visual next to the short text it supports. Keep only the calls, files, props, states, and boundaries needed to answer the user's current question or the options to resolve the current discussion point.\n\nYou may use one of these, you may use several, it is unlikely you will use all of them. Use your judgement and don't overwhelm the user.\n\n### Evidence\n\nConcrete evidence that the change works. Show a before and after.\n\nScreenshots are S-tier - when the environment is set up for it and the change is visual.\n\nExecution-based evidence is A-tier. Test results, console output. Show the exact test that now fails and passes, using pseudocode.\n\n### Merge Danger\n\nDescribe whether it's a one-way or two-way door. You can walk back through two-way doors, but not one-way doors. A PR that is cheap to roll back is lower risk. Changes that involve destructive actions or hard-to-reverse decisions are one-way doors.\n\nThe blast radius is the potential impact or scope of the changes introduced by this PR. Consider all possibilities. Examples are layout shift, breakages for consumers, mobile responsiveness, etc.\n"}]}}

{"parentUuid":"af0420b7-177a-4a0f-9e80-a82ebc96b0e8","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-opus-5-5","id":"msg_011Cg93QPys3P7t7xmvqnAhs","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01DgqNNhpAMYDVTTxNxb5GKa","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/Users/yining/orca/workspaces/iphs400-mp2-cms/IPHS400-Mini-Project-2/docs/handoff/06_25-to-next_20261018.md","content":"# Handoff: 大巴扎攻略站 CMS, after #25\n\nRepo: `/Users/yining/orca/workspaces/iphs400-mp2-cms/IPHS400-Mini-Project-2` (a git worktree on branch\n`Avulpix0412/IPHS400-Mini-Project-2`, reused for every ticket; do not delete it, or the branch, after merging).\nThe main checkout is `/Users/yining/code/iphs400-mp2-cms` (on `main`), which holds the real local `cms.db`.\n\n## Where things stand\n\n- **#25 (Beijing time, scrolling tables) is done, merged and closed.**\n  - PR: https://github.com/Avulpix0412/iphs400-mp2-cms/pull/28 (merge commit `3b2f3a0`; work commit `6021123`).\n    The PR body has the file map, test evidence and merge danger.\n  - The `/code-review` findings, how each was resolved, the user's choices and the decisions made while building\n    are in https://github.com/Avulpix0412/iphs400-mp2-cms/issues/25#issuecomment-6245386069\n  - At handoff, 439 tests passed and pyright reported 0 errors.\n- **The branch is one commit ahead of `main`:** `c799dfb` (transcripts 15–17, handoffs 03–05, ledger rows). It\n  is pushed, and reaches `main` with the next PR.\n- **Not committed yet:** this file, this session's transcript (18, written by the SessionEnd hook), and this\n  session's ledger rows. They go into the next \"Add transcript NN\" commit, after the credential scan.\n- `.claude/state/phase` says `25`. Update it when the next stage starts.\n- **The real `cms.db` still hasn't been re-seeded since T08** (see handoff 05). Ask the user before running\n  `scripts/seed_demo.py` in the main checkout.\n\n## Next tickets (open issues; ask the user which one to take)\n\n- #11 S1 images (stretch). The spec lets a Tournament item own images and have an optional cover. T08 left\n  covers out on purpose, for this ticket.\n- #12 S2 hosted console (stretch, last; ADR-003 supersedes ADR-001 then).\n\nRead the ticket, spec #1 (`gh issue view 1`), and `CONTEXT.md` before coding, as `CLAUDE.md` requires.\n\n## What the next tickets must fit around (from #25, not obvious from the spec)\n\n- **Times are shown only through `app/times.py`.**\n  - `beijing_time` (`2026-10-17 21:05`) and `beijing_date` (`2026-10-18`) are Jinja filters in both the console\n    environment (`app/web.py`) and the site environment (`app/publish.py`).\n  - Both return `\"\"` for a NULL time.\n  - Storage and every comparison stay UTC. The offset is a fixed UTC+8, not `zoneinfo` (see the #25 comment\n    for why).\n- **`test_no_template_prints_a_stored_time_without_converting_it` scans every template.**\n  - It fails on any `{{ … }}` that names a `…_at` field without `|beijing_time` or `|beijing_date`.\n  - Name every new timestamp column `…_at` (an image's `created_at`, say), so the scan covers it.\n  - `tournament_date` is a calendar date the Admin types. It is not converted.\n- **Wide console tables** go in `<div class=\"scroll\">` (`templates/admin/base.html`). A cell holding a title or\n  a sentence gets `class=\"wrap\"`, or `.scroll td { white-space: nowrap }` puts it all on one line.\n  - The Guide list, Trash, dashboard review queue, Users, Pages, Tournaments and Terms tables already follow this.\n- **Displayed times no longer carry milliseconds,** so two changes in the same minute look the same in the\n  console. Prove an update happened some other way. `test_publishing_a_revision_replaces_the_guides_content_and_keeps_its_url`\n  now checks the content-list order (most recently updated first).\n- **`CONTEXT.md`** has a new **Beijing time (北京时间)** entry under \"Time\".\n\n## Working conventions\n\nEverything in the \"Working conventions\" sections of handoffs 01 to 05 (`docs/handoff/0{1,2,3,4,5}_*.md`) still\nholds.\n\nAdditions this session:\n- **Issues without a T-number** (like #25): the user chose commits that start `#25:`, a phase file reading `25`,\n  and a closing commit ending `Closes #25`. Ask again for the next one rather than assuming.\n- **Typecheck command** must name the new test file, because the `test_t0*.py` glob misses it:\n  `uvx pyright --pythonpath .venv/bin/python app scripts/seed_demo.py tests/conftest.py tests/test_t0*.py tests/test_console_links.py tests/test_25_beijing_time.py`\n- **Two more agreed seams, for #25 only:**\n  - unit tests that call `app/times.py` directly;\n  - the template scan, which treats templates as files.\n\n  Confirm any new seam with the user, as before.\n- **Testing times against the clock.** SQLite stamps every time itself, so no console action can store a chosen\n  one. The helpers in `tests/test_25_beijing_time.py` are:\n  - `started`: a fixture holding a minute before the test began;\n  - `beijing_minutes_since(start)` and `beijing_dates_since(start)`;\n  - `times_on(page)`;\n  - `assert_beijing_now(page, started)`: every time on the page is a Beijing minute from this test.\n\n  The Seam 2 date test can only fail on the old code between 00:00 and 08:00 Beijing time.
